_comment: GATED mutation lane (ENFORCEMENT.md). Pinned to the highest-stakes pure modules — turn routing, credential resolution, prompt assembly — where a surviving mutant means a test asserts presence-of-behavior without asserting correctness (the `isVllmBackend`-lying-gate class neo founded this on). Unlike the exploratory stryker.config.json (break:null), this FAILS the build below `thresholds.break` — a ratchet-down regression guard. NOT in `pnpm check` (mutation runs are minutes; the check budget is structural-fast) — run on demand via `pnpm test:mutation:gate` + from CI. SCHEDULED: skeleton until the three target files + their tests exist (Phase 4c/5); `break` stays null until then.
_plugins_comment: Explicit plugin paths — pnpm's strict layout breaks Stryker auto-discovery.
_mutate_comment: EXACTLY the highest-stakes files — no globs. Keep tight: break is calibrated to this set's measured score. orbweaver targets (Phase 4c/5 — do not exist yet).
_ignore_comment: Prune the sandbox copy — same shape as the base config. .cache/** (8.8G vLLM venv; its lib64 symlink crashes copyfile EISDIR) and .models/** (25G HF weights) MUST be excluded or the sandbox copy explodes.
_coverage_comment: coverageAnalysis NOT set — the vitest-runner ignores it and always uses perTest.
_concurrency_comment: 24-core / 125GB box; default is n-1 (=23). 16 → ~8 checker + ~8 runner processes with headroom. Bump toward 20 for a dedicated run.
_thresholds_comment: break is the GATE — Stryker exits non-zero when the AGGREGATE score across the pinned files drops below it. CALIBRATE at Phase 4c/5: measure the aggregate, set break ~6pts under it, then ratchet UP as suites gain real assertions (neo's history: aggregate climbed 55.41%→66.31% over a hardening pass; break sat at 60). Stays null until the targets exist — a null break never fails, so the skeleton is safe to commit.
